tools.name: raygun_list_applications
tools.description: List the Raygun applications the token can access. Start here to get application identifiers. GET /applications (scope applications:read).

tools.name: raygun_get_application
tools.description: Get one application by identifier: name, plan, whether crash, APM and RUM data have arrived. GET /applications/{application-identifier}.

tools.name: raygun_list_error_groups
tools.description: List error groups (distinct errors) for an application, with status and last occurrence. GET /applications/{id}/error-groups.

tools.name: raygun_get_error_group
tools.description: Get one error group: message, status (active, resolved, ignored), first and last occurrence. GET /applications/{id}/error-groups/{group}.

tools.name: raygun_list_error_instances
tools.description: List individual occurrences of one error group, newest first. GET /applications/{id}/error-groups/{group}/instances.

tools.name: raygun_get_error_instance
tools.description: Get one error occurrence with its stack trace, client, request and breadcrumbs. Omit error_instance_id to get the latest occurrence of the group. GET .../instance/{instance} or .../instance/latest.

tools.name: raygun_resolve_error_group
tools.description: Mark an error group as resolved. Reversible with raygun_activate_error_group. POST /applications/{id}/error-groups/{group}/resolve.

tools.name: raygun_ignore_error_group
tools.description: Ignore an error group, so new occurrences do not raise alerts. Reversible with raygun_activate_error_group. POST .../ignore.

tools.name: raygun_activate_error_group
tools.description: Set an error group back to active (undo resolve or ignore). POST .../activate.

tools.name: raygun_comment_error_group
tools.description: Add a comment to an error group. Creates a new comment each call. POST .../comment.

tools.name: raygun_list_deployments
tools.description: List deployments of an application (release markers used for error tracking). GET /applications/{id}/deployments.

tools.name: raygun_get_latest_deployment
tools.description: Get the most recent deployment of an application. GET /applications/{id}/deployments/latest.

tools.name: raygun_get_deployment
tools.description: Get one deployment by identifier: version, owner, commit and deploy time. GET /applications/{id}/deployments/{deployment}.

tools.name: raygun_create_deployment
tools.description: Record a deployment (release marker) for an application. Creates a new record each call. POST /applications/{id}/deployments.

tools.name: raygun_list_customers
tools.description: List end-user customers seen by an application (identified users). GET /applications/{id}/customers.

tools.name: raygun_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer seen by an application. GET /applications/{id}/customers/{customer}.

tools.name: raygun_list_sessions
tools.description: List real-user sessions for an application. GET /applications/{id}/sessions.

tools.name: raygun_get_session
tools.description: Get one real-user session: page views and errors in order. GET /applications/{id}/sessions/{session}.

tools.name: raygun_list_pages
tools.description: List monitored web or mobile pages of an application with their performance data. GET /applications/{id}/pages.

tools.name: raygun_get_page
tools.description: Get one monitored page by identifier. GET /applications/{id}/pages/{page}.

tools.name: raygun_search_apm_issues
tools.description: Search APM issues (performance problems such as slow queries or N+1 queries) in a time window of at most 30 days. POST /applications/{id}/apm/issues/search.

tools.name: raygun_get_apm_issue
tools.description: Get one APM issue with its occurrence metrics and example traces. GET /applications/{id}/apm/issues/{issue}.

tools.name: raygun_search_apm_traces
tools.description: Search APM request traces in a time window of at most 30 days, optionally by duration or HTTP status. POST /applications/{id}/apm/traces/search.

tools.name: raygun_get_apm_trace
tools.description: Get one APM trace: its calls, threads and issues. GET /applications/{id}/apm/traces/{trace}.

tools.name: raygun_get_error_time_series
tools.description: Count error instances over time for an application, optionally for some error groups. POST /metrics/{id}/errors/time-series.

tools.name: raygun_list_teams
tools.description: List the teams of the plan the token belongs to. GET /teams (scope teams:read).

tools.name: raygun_get_team
tools.description: Get one team by identifier. GET /teams/{team}.

tools.name: raygun_list_plans
tools.description: List the Raygun plan(s) the token belongs to, with limits. GET /plans.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: raygun_get_error_group, raygun_search_apm_issues, raygun_get_apm_issue, raygun_search_apm_traces, raygun_get_apm_trace, raygun_get_error_time_series · Private data: raygun_list_applications, raygun_create_deployment, raygun_list_teams, raygun_list_plans · Public sink: raygun_resolve_error_group, raygun_ignore_error_group, raygun_activate_error_group, raygun_comment_error_group, raygun_create_deployment, raygun_search_apm_issues, raygun_search_apm_traces, raygun_get_error_time_series.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: raygun_get_error_group, raygun_search_apm_issues, raygun_get_apm_issue, raygun_search_apm_traces, raygun_get_apm_trace, raygun_get_error_time_series · Private data: raygun_list_applications, raygun_create_deployment, raygun_list_teams, raygun_list_plans · Public sink: raygun_resolve_error_group, raygun_ignore_error_group, raygun_activate_error_group, raygun_comment_error_group, raygun_create_deployment, raygun_search_apm_issues, raygun_search_apm_traces, raygun_get_error_time_series

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
